d:
The Spurs defeated the Jazz, 119-97 tonight in San Antonio. Dylan Harper finished with a team-high 17 points along with 8 assists and 7 rebounds for the Spurs, while Stephon Castle tallied 16 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Lauri Markkanen recorded 22 points, 8 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Spurs improve their record to 5-2 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-6 for the season.
